name: My Beautiful AI
source: Tokyo in the year 2050. You play as Zachary Wright, and you are the lead researcher and scientist in a team conducting studies on the field of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics. During the span of less than a week, Aiikasu, the first AI to be made as a result of the study, and a woman from your past will change everything.
translation: 2050年的东京。你扮演扎卡里·赖特，是一支在人工智能和机器人领域进行研究的团队的首席研究员和科学家。在不到一周的时间里，作为研究成果诞生的第一位AI艾卡丝，以及一个来自你过去的女人，将改变一切。
